desc:
[ ⚠️ Contains flashing lights and loud audio. If you have epilepsy, it is advised that you do not play this game. 🚨]

🌑 Enter a place where time fades, shadows whisper your name, and dark forces drag you into an inescapable realm—where only two fates await: hunt... or be hunted. 🎯

🕯️ Welcome to Lost: Sandbox, where you have all been abandoned. Step into this domain, and you will encounter all kinds of familiar faces—whether friends, foes, or something in between, you are bound to meet them at some point. 👁️

🔔 Can you hear the echo of distant footsteps? Can you feel someone watching you in the dark? With every toll of the clock, you are reminded... no one leaves this place easily. ⏳

⚰️ Here, every decision could be your last.

📌 [Note: This game will no longer generate any profit; it is purely for fun. I never actually expected anyone to play it. There may be many bugs and issues...]
